description: Retrieve current, version-aware documentation and code examples from one Docsy library, or request source links only (response: links) without loading or indexing document bodies. Resolve the library ID first unless the exact ID is known. Keep each query to one concept and do not call this tool more than 3 times per question.

libraryId.description: Exact Docsy library ID such as /org/project or /org/project/version.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (snippets or links); omit to use the production default.

query.description: Specific documentation concept to retrieve. Use one topic per query and never include secrets, credentials, PII, proprietary code, or confidential data.

response.description: Choose links to search existing publisher/version metadata without loading, parsing, embedding or saving documentation page contents. Defaults to snippets.

name: query-docs
title: Query Documentation
